blocks.en: 5.4 Approach B: what the checker learns
blocks.zh: 5.4 方法B:检查人员学到什么

blocks.en: The untuned checker could not do the task in either form of prompt. In the absence of examples, 52 % of the answers of the untuned checker to planted errors lay outside the required form, where most of them repeated the input or stated the same meaning in the target language. A lenient reading of these answers changed the gain of fine-tuning only from +68 to +66 points for error types without conditions, which shows that the answer form does not explain the gain. Without examples, the untuned checker detected 19 % of the planted errors at 19 % alerts, a result that is close to chance. In contrast, the untuned checker flagged almost everything with 99 % alerts when it received three examples. The fine-tuned checker detected 93 % to 98 % of the word-level errors, where gpt-oss-120b planted the training errors and Gemma 4 (26B) planted the test errors. In addition, the answers of the fine-tuned checker named the error and quoted the values. The quoted values were correct in 92 % to 99 % of the flagged polarity errors, 69 % to 91 % of the numbers, and 39 % to 74 % of the units. The untuned checker never quoted the values correctly.
blocks.zh: 未调试的检查器无法以任意一种即时方式完成任务 。 在没有实例的情况下,未调试的检查器对植入错误的回答有52%位于要求的形式之外,其中多数重复输入或者在目标语言中表示相同的含义. 对这些答案的宽宏大量解读,将微调的得分仅从+68变为+66的得分,对错误类型无条件,这表明答案表并不能解释得分. 没有实例,未调试的检查器在19%的警报中发现了19%的植入错误,这一结果几乎是偶然的。 相比之下,未调试的检查器收到三个实例时,几乎以99%的提示标出所有东西. 微调的检查器检测到了93%到98%的词层错误,gpt-oss-120b植入了训练错误,Gemma 4(26B)植入了测试错误. 此外,微调检查器的答案将错误命名并引用了数值. 引用的数值正确,92%到99%的标定极性差错,69%到91%的数字,39%到74%的单位。 未调节的检查器从未正确引用这些值 。

blocks.en: Numbers and units transferred only partly from the training changes to the different changes of the test, as shown in Fig. 5 . For example, a changed digit was detected in 93 % to 99 % of cases, and a number ten times larger was detected in 86 % to 95 %. However, a number ten times smaller was detected only in 4 % to 55 % of cases. Moreover, “Nm” written as “N” was never detected, resulting in 0 % in every seed, while “kW” written as “W” was detected in 10 % to 30 % of cases. The checker learned the kinds of changes it saw in training more than a general comparison of numbers and units.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,数字和单位仅部分从培训变化转入测试的不同变化。 例如,在93%到99%的病例中发现数字变化,在86%到95%的病例中发现数字变化是10倍。 然而,只有4%到55%的病例发现的病例数量是十倍。 此外,从未发现用“Nm”写成的“Nm”,导致每颗种子的“kW”为0%,而用“W”写成的“kW”为10%至30%的病例被发现。 检查员了解了在培训中看到的各种变化,而不是对数字和单位的一般比较。

blocks.en: The fine-tuned checker flagged 20 of the 500 unmodified Finnish units. The 500 units are all unmodified Finnish units of the rake manual, and the checker of seed 1 checked all 500. In addition, the 20 unflagged units of the check were drawn at random from the other 480 units. The alerts of the rule check on these Finnish units were not part of the check. In a Finnish check, only one of these 20 alerts showed a real difference, which was a missing “whenever possible”, while the other 19 shared the same meaning. These false alerts were triggered by exactly two surface cues, namely the normal Finnish obligation “tulee” read as “should” in 10 alerts and a negation reported missing where the Finnish used a positive or restrictive form in 9 alerts. The Finnish translator often restructured sentences, sometimes more compactly, with the same meaning, which made some items hard to judge. Of the 20 unflagged units, two differed, where one contained an added word and one had an alignment error of the corpus. Therefore, the detection rates of planted errors do not carry over to the precision of alerts on real translations, at least in Finnish.
blocks.zh: 微调的检查器标记了500个未修改的芬兰单位中的20个。 这500个单位都是无修改的芬兰单位的雷克手册,1号种子的检查员检查了所有的500个. 此外,抽查的20个未悬挂标记的单位是任意从其他480个单位抽取的. 有关这些芬兰单位的规则检查的警报不属于检查范围。 在芬兰的一次检查中,这20次警报中只有一次显示真正的不同,即“尽可能”缺失,而另外19次则具有相同的含义。 这些虚假警报是由两个表面提示触发的,即芬兰的正常义务“tulee”在10次警报中被理解为“应当”以及据报告在9次警报中芬兰人使用正或限制性形式的否定。 芬兰语翻译者经常对句子进行重构,有时更为紧凑,含义相同,这使得一些项目难以判断. 在20个未加标记的单位中,有两个不同,一个包含一个加词,一个有校正错误。 因此,安装错误的检测率不会延续到对真实翻译的精确警报,至少是芬兰语。

blocks.en: The rule check alone detected every planted number and unit error, which produced alerts on 0.8 % of the unmodified units versus false alarms on 38 % of the meaning-preserving edits, including every thousands separator and every unit spelling such as N·m. In addition, the checker alone detected 90 % of the errors without conditions, with 3 % alerts and 13 % false alarms. The combination detected 97 % of these errors, with 4 % alerts and 39 % false alarms, as shown in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 规则检查单检测到每个植入数和单位错误,这些错误在0.8%的未修改单位上产生警报,而在38%的保存意义编辑上产生假警报,包括每千个分隔符和每个单位拼写如N.m. 此外,单是检查器就毫无条件地检测出90%的错误,3%的警报和13%的假警报. 如表6所示,该组合检测出97%的错误,4%的警报和39%的假警报。

blocks.en: Table 6: Detection of planted errors per error type, alerts on unmodified text, and false alarms on meaning-preserving edits in percent, for the rule check alone, the fine-tuned checker alone (mean of three seeds), and both combined, across 24 languages.
blocks.zh: 表 6 检测每个错误类型的植入错误,对未修改文本的提醒,以及对保留意义编辑的虚假提醒,以百分比表示,仅用于规则检查,仅用于微调的检查器(指三种种子),两者加在一起,共涉及24种语言.

blocks.en: 5.5 Copied and new text
blocks.zh: 5.5 复制文本和新文本

blocks.en: The fine-tuned checker detected 88 % to 93 % of the errors without conditions in every similarity group, which shows no loss on copied text in Table 7 . However, approach A lost in every group, where exact copies dropped from 85 % to 61 % whereas new text dropped from 90 % to 75 %. For weakened obligations, the performance fell from 94 % to 26 % in exact copies versus from 94 % to 42 % in new text. In addition, the alerts of the fine-tuned checker remained between 2 % and 5 % in every group.
blocks.zh: 微调的检查器在每一个相似性组中检测到88%到93%的差错,这表明在表7中复制的文本没有丢失。 然而,每一组的A类方法都丢失了,准确的复制率从85%降至61%,而新文本则从90%降至75%。 就弱化的义务而言,业绩从94%下降到26%,而新文本从94%下降到42%。 此外,微调检查器的警报在每个组中仍然在2%至5%之间.

blocks.en: Table 7: Detection of planted errors without conditions in percent, per similarity group of the test text to the training text, for untuned and fine-tuned (mean of three seeds) versions of approach A and approach B.
blocks.zh: 表7:检测到无条件安装的错误百分比,按测试文本与培训文本的相似性组别,用于未校对和微调(指三种种子)方法A和方法B的版本。

blocks.en: 5.6 Languages
blocks.zh: 5.6 语文

blocks.en: The opposite directions of the two approaches appeared in all 24 languages, as shown in Fig. 6 . In every language, approach A lost weakened obligations by 10 to 85 points, whereas approach B gained in almost every language and error type. However, approach B showed no change for Slovak units and Bulgarian obligation with 3 items and 29 points fewer for Greek units. In addition, the smallest positive gains of approach B were observed for Latvian and Romanian numbers and units, where the gains ranged from 2 to 10 points.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,两种方法的相反方向出现在所有24种语言中。 在每种语言中,方法A丧失了10至85分的弱化义务,而方法B几乎在每一种语言和错误类型中都有增加。 然而,方法B显示斯洛伐克单位和保加利亚的义务没有变化,希腊单位有3项,减少29分。 此外,对拉脱维亚和罗马尼亚的数目和单位而言,方法B的积极成果最小,其收益从2点到10点不等。

blocks.en: The untuned checker behaved very differently by language, as illustrated in Fig. 7 . In Danish, French, Italian, Norwegian, Swedish, and Hungarian, the untuned checker detected 0 % to 9 % of the planted errors and answered “Same meaning.” to almost every item. In contrast, it flagged up to 74 % of the planted errors in Latvian. The fine-tuned checker reached 81 % to 100 % for the word-level types in every language, apart from Bulgarian obligation with 3 items. Units were the weakest type of the fine-tuned checker in every language, with values between 47 % and 92 %.
blocks.zh: 未调试的检查器在语言上的表现非常不同,如Fig所示. 7. 在丹麦语、法语、意大利语、挪威语、瑞典语和匈牙利语中,未调试的检查器检测出所埋设的误差的0%至9%,并对几乎所有物品回答“同一含义”。 与此相反,它标出了拉脱维亚语中74%的布设错误。 微调的检查器在每种语言的词级类型中达到了81%至100%,而保加利亚的义务有3项。 单位是每种语言中微调检查器中最弱的类型,数值在47%至92%之间。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Why the two training workflows act in opposite directions
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 为何两个训练工作流程的操作方向相反

blocks.en: In approach A, the back-translator learns to produce the English version of the training manuals. Each English sentence is the target of about 20 training pairs, and the fine-tuned back-translator reproduced the memorised English side of these multi-parallel data most of all in text close to the training text (Section 5.3 ), similarly as in [ 21 ] . In the training pairs of this study, a faithful back-translation of the other language version lacks an obligation such as “must” in 40 % of the pairs where the English version contains it. Many of these differences are style, for example an imperative or an infinitive where the English writes “must be checked”. These training pairs teach that English instructions take “must” whatever the other language version says, so the fine-tuned back-translator restores “must” where the translation says “should”. In this study, hiding grew with the training intensity (Fig. 4 ), similarly as memorisation grows with the number of repetitions of a training example in [ 24 , 23 ] . The back-translator repaired planted errors on their way back, similarly as reported for general systems [ 3 , 8 , 9 ] , and fine-tuning on the manufacturer’s own manuals strengthened this repair. The results support the pre-registered hypothesis, which states that fine-tuning raises hiding more in text close to the training text (Section 5.3 ). In addition, hiding occurred also on new text, which remained far above the level of the untuned model. The memory of single training sentences and learned conventions of the operator manuals provide two proposed explanations, although this study did not isolate their separate contributions.
blocks.zh: 在办法A中,后方翻译人员学习编写培训手册的英文版。 每个英文句子都是约20个训练对的目标,经过微调的后译者将这些多平行数据的记忆性英文侧面复制下来,最接近训练文本的文本(第5.3节),类似[21]. 在这项研究的训练对子中,忠实的反译其他语言版本缺乏义务,如在英语版本包含的40%的对子中“必须”的义务。 其中许多差异是风格的,例如,英文写作“必须检查”的必然性或无限性。 这些培训对子教导说,无论其他语文版本怎么说,英文指示都“必须”,因此,经过微调的后译者恢复了“必须”翻译中“应该”的说法。 在这项研究中,隐藏随着训练强度(图4)的增加而增加,同样,在[24、23]中,随着重复训练实例的次数的增加,记忆也在增加。 后翻译员在返回途中修复了布设的错误,类似一般系统[3、8、9]的报告,并对制造商自己的手册进行微调,加强了这种修复。 结果支持预先登记的假设,该假设指出,微调会增加文本中与培训文本相近之处的隐藏(第5.3节)。 此外,还隐藏在新的文本上,这些文本远远高于未调整模型的水平。 单一培训句子的记忆和操作人员手册的学习惯例提供了两个拟议解释,尽管本研究并没有孤立它们各自的贡献。

blocks.en: In approach B, the checker learns the difference itself as its target, not the English text. In short, the checker workflow rewards reporting a difference, whereas the back-translator workflow rewards restoring the expected English text. The checker generalised to word-level errors of another planter, but it transferred numbers and units only partly. The two training workflows differ in training target, data, supervision, and selection, which means the design does not isolate one cause. However, the difference in training target, restoring the English text versus reporting a difference, remains a plausible explanation of the opposite directions. In addition, the checker learned from correct pairs that left out stylistic differences in an element, whereas the back-translator learned from all pairs and never saw an error kept in its English target. Both differences likely contributed to the opposite directions, and training both workflows on the same filtered data, including pairs that keep an error for the back-translator, represents a next step.
blocks.zh: 在方法B中,检查者学习差异本身是它的目标,而不是英文文本. 简言之,检查工作流程奖励报告差异,而后翻译工作流程奖励恢复预期的英文文本。 检查器概括到另一个计程器的单词级别错误,但它只转移了部分数字和单位. 两种训练工作流程在训练目标,数据,监督,和选择方面有所不同,这意味着设计不孤立一个原因. 然而,在培训目标上的差异——恢复英文文本与报告不同之处——仍然是对相反方向的合理解释。 此外,检查者从正确的对子中吸取了教训,这些对子在元素中忽略了风格差异,而后翻译者则从所有对子中吸取教训,从未看到其英语目标中保留过错误. 这两种差异都可能导致相反的方向,对两个工作流程进行相同的过滤数据的培训,包括保留后翻译错误的对子,是下一步。

blocks.en: 6.2 What this means for checking manuals
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 这对检查手册意味着什么

blocks.en: A proposed workflow, which was not tested in this study, involves the checker reading every unit, while a competent translator receives every alert and every answer outside the required form. Unflagged units still need the review required by the standards, because the checker misses some errors. In addition, a reviewer may come to trust the “Same meaning.” label and skim unflagged units. In addition, an alert rate of 3 % is not a measured reduction of the review work, as most alerts in Finnish were false (Section 5.4 ) and each false alert costs review time. Human translators restructure sentences with the same meaning, whereas the checker was trained on pairs where a planted change is the only difference. The checker learned language-specific forms of obligation and negation as error cues, and the filter of its correct training pairs, which had removed such forms, likely contributed to this. In addition, keeping such forms as “Same meaning.” examples in every language is a next step. A simple rule check comparing numbers and units detected every planted number and unit change similarly as in [ 16 ] . However, it alerted on harmless rewrites such as thousands separators, meaning its normalisation of numbers and units needs care in every language. In addition, the rule check and the checker together covered the weakest types of the checker (Section 5.4 ). In contrast, approach A with a fine-tuned back-translator hides exactly the errors the reviewer looks for. In addition, pooled detection rates hide weak types, where the checker never detected a tightening torque in Nm changed to N, and its seeds spread from 40 % to 86 % for units. The study where back-translation helped most used a general back-translator [ 11 ] . Therefore, the benefit of back-translation for a reader who knows only English depends on a faithful back-translator, while fine-tuning on the same manuals takes this faithfulness away. User studies found that back-translation raises the confidence of users more than the quality of their translations [ 10 ] , and that users may trust fluent but wrong output [ 12 ] . The check tests consistency with the English reference instead of engineering correctness, which means an unsafe instruction translated faithfully passes the check. The fine-tuned checker could support the review by competent persons; it does not replace it. Similarly, an earlier study proposed that an LLM assistant for operators guides the operator to the source text of the operator manual instead of acting as the final authority [ 1 ] . In the same way, the checker directs the attention of the reviewer to units, and the reviewer makes the decision.
blocks.zh: 本研究未测试的拟议工作流程涉及检查员阅读每个单元,而胜任的翻译员则在规定的表格之外收到每一个提示和每个答案. 未悬挂标记的单位仍然需要按照标准要求进行审查,因为检查器漏掉了一些错误. 此外,审查人员可能相信“同一含义”。 此外,3%的警戒率不是对审查工作的量度削减,因为大多数芬兰语的警报都是虚假的(第5.4节),而且每一次虚假的警报费用审查时间。 人类翻译对句子进行重构,其含义相同,而检查师则接受对子训练,其中植入变化是唯一的区别. 检查员学习了特定语言的义务形式和否定作为错误提示,并筛选了正确的培训配对,从而删除了这些表格。 此外,保留“同一含义”等形式。 简单的规则检查比较数字和检测到的单位,每个植入的数字和单位变化与[16]类似. 然而,它提醒人们注意一些无害的重写,例如数千个分隔器,这意味着它使数字和单位正常化需要每种语言的注意。 此外,规则检查和检查机一起涵盖最弱的检查机类型(第5.4节)。 相比之下,带有微调后翻译的A方法则完全隐藏了审查者寻找的错误. 此外,集合检测率隐藏了弱类型,检查者从未检测到Nm的收紧扭矩变为N,其种子的传播率从40%到86%的单位. 后翻译帮助大部分人使用一般后翻译的研究[11]. 因此,对只懂英语的读者而言,背译的好处取决于忠实的背译者,而精细地调整同样的手册则会使这种忠实化. 用户研究发现,回译比翻译质量提高用户的信心[10],用户可能相信流畅但错误的输出[12]. 检查测试与英文引用的一致性而不是工程正确性,这意味着一个不安全的指令翻译忠实通过检查. 微调核对员可以支持主管人员的审查;它不能取代审查。 同样,早先的一项研究建议,操作员的LLM助理应指导操作员使用操作员手册的源文本,而不是作为最终权威[1]. 同样,由检查员将审查员的注意力引向单位,由审查员决定.

blocks.en: A human translator may also add or change content on purpose, for example words for better readability in the local language, or a sentence after feedback from that market in a later revision, possibly agreed with the manufacturer. Such a deviation is not a wrong translation, whereas a checker that compares two texts cannot tell an intended deviation from an unintended one. Therefore, this decision needs knowledge of the translation process from a person or from a further AI component, and some work remains for the human reviewer, whose attention the checker can direct. A hypothesis for a next step, not tested in this study, is that translations by a large LLM may stay closer to the structure of the English version and cause fewer false alerts. However, such translations may contain other kinds of errors, such as omissions and added content, and the same checker on LLM translations of the same manuals could test this.
blocks.zh: 人文翻译者也可以故意添加或更改内容,例如用文字来提高当地语言的可读性,或者在稍后的修订中从该市场得到反馈后加一句,可能与制造商达成一致. 这种偏差并不是一个错误的翻译,而比较两个文本的核对器不能说明有意偏离意向。 因此,这一决定需要一个人或另一个AI组成部分对翻译过程的了解,一些工作仍留给人审查者,检查者可以引导其注意力. 对于下一步,本研究没有测试的一个假设是,用大型LLM进行翻译可能会保持更接近英文版的结构,引起较少的假警报. 然而,这种翻译可能包含其他类型的错误,如遗漏和增加的内容,同一手册的LLM翻译的同一核对器可以检验这一点。

blocks.en: The explanations of the checker quoted wrong values in some cases, for example 39 % to 74 % correct for units. In addition, the answers of the checker provide explicit feedback of the kind of LLM explanations; in a user study, such explanations led to more over-reliance than back-translation (13.3 % against 7.2 %) [ 11 ] , so a reviewer needs correct explanations. Nevertheless, this proof of concept indicates that such support might be possible within operator manuals of agricultural machinery. Firmer conclusions need a far more comprehensive corpus with much more data. Moreover, the proper size of the model remains open, whether it should be smaller than, similar to or larger than the 1.7 billion parameters used here. The EuroLLM family already offers models with 9 and 22 billion parameters [ 25 , 26 ] . However, another model family than EuroLLM may also be a better base for fine-tuning, and this question stays open. For example, the untuned EuroLLM-9B scored similar to or below other open models of similar size in a study that summarised German court decisions [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh: 对检查者的解释引用了某些情况下的错误值,例如,39%至74%的单位正确。 此外,检查者的答复对LLM解释的种类提供了明确的反馈;在一项用户研究中,这种解释导致的过度依赖比反译(13.3%对7.2%)[11],因此审查者需要正确的解释. 然而,这种概念的证明表明,在农业机械操作手册中可以提供这种支持。 更坚定的结论需要一个更全面得多的数据库。 此外,该模型的适当尺寸仍然开放,无论它是否应该小于,类似于或大于此处使用的17亿参数. EuroLLM家族已经提供了90和220亿参数的模型[25,26]. 然而,欧洲LLM之外的另一个模范家族也可能是精细化的更好基础,这个问题仍然开放. 例如,未对调的EuroLLM-9B在一项总结德国法院判决的研究中得分与大小类似的其他开放模型类似或低于这些模型. [51].

blocks.en: 6.3 The English version as reference
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 作为参考的英文本

blocks.en: This study treated the English version as the reference for every check. It is not known whether English was the source language of each operator manual. The source language may depend on the machine type, for example, Dutch, Norwegian, German or English. We assume that this corpus has no single source language for the whole set of manuals. In addition, it is not known whether all translations come directly from one source. A chain of translations, which functions like a tree, is possible as well. A speculative example of this structure is a set of paths from Dutch to German, Dutch to Norwegian to Swedish to Danish, or Dutch to English to Finnish. It is a general situation for any agricultural machinery manufacturer that translation processes vary highly.
blocks.zh: 这项研究将英文版作为每张支票的参考。 不清楚每本操作员手册的源语言是否为英语。 源语言可能依赖于机器类型,例如荷兰语,挪威语,德语或英语. 我们假设这本手册没有一套手册的单一来源语言。 此外,还不清楚所有翻译是否直接来自一个来源。 连锁翻译,其功能如树,也是可能的. 这种结构的一个推测性例子是一套从荷兰语到德语,从荷兰语到挪威语到瑞典语到丹麦语,或者从荷兰语到英语到芬兰语的路径. 对于任何农业机械制造商来说,翻译工艺差异很大是一种普遍情况。

blocks.en: The Machinery Directive distinguishes “Original instructions” from a “Translation of the original instructions” [ 30 ] . IEC/IEEE 82079-1 describes translation from the original language into a target language by competent translators [ 6 ] . A difference between the English version and another language version may come from the translation path and not only from an error. The English version remains a practical reference for one expert who reads English.
blocks.zh: 机械指令将“原始指示”与“原始指示的翻译”区分开来[30]。 IEC/IEEE 82079-1描述主管翻译从原文翻译为目标语言[6]. 英文版与另一语言版的区别可能来自翻译路径,而不仅仅是错误. 英文本仍然是一位读英文的专家的实际参考。

blocks.en: 6.4 Languages in tuning
blocks.zh: 6.4 调音语言

blocks.en: This study fine-tuned one model on all 24 language versions of the operator manuals together, where the opposite directions of approach A and approach B appeared in every language (Section 5.6 ). However, the earlier studies that fine-tuned EuroLLM, which are described in Section 2.3 [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] , cover at most eight language pairs. None of the studies found compares a set of 24 European languages.
blocks.zh: 这项研究对操作员手册所有24种语文版本的一个模式进行了微调,每种语文都出现了办法A和办法B的相反方向(第5.6节)。 然而,早先对EuroLLM进行微调的研究,在第2.3节[27,28,29]中有所描述,最多涵盖了8种语言对. 没有发现任何一项研究可以比较24种欧洲语言。

blocks.en: 6.5 Building the corpus
blocks.zh: 6.5 建立实体

blocks.en: The corpus was more laborious to build than expected. Earlier studies with operator manuals of the same manufacturer found an identical page layout across three and six language versions [ 52 , 1 ] , which made page-based alignment look simple. However, single translations inserted or omitted pages in the 12 manuals of this study, and one manual reflowed its text in every language. As a result, every language version needed its own page map, and that specific manual was left out. In addition, the automatic validation of the alignment needed calibration by the author and judged only part of the pairs, so alignment errors remain, as the Finnish check found one among 40 units (Section 5.4 ). This experience shows that a study of this kind should reserve sufficient time for the preparation of the data.
blocks.zh: 炸弹的制造比预期的要费力 早先与同一制造商的操作员手册进行的研究发现,在三种和六种语言版本[52,1]之间有相同的页面布局,这使得基于页面的对齐看起来很简单. 然而,在本研究报告的12份手册中插入或省略了单页译本,一份手册以每种语文重新转发了文本。 因此,每个语言版本都需要自己的页图,而这个具体的手册被忽略了. 此外,对校正的自动验证需要作者校准,并且只判断部分配对,因此校正错误依然存在,因为芬兰的检查在40个单元中发现了一个(第5.4节). 经验表明,这种研究应该为编制数据留出足够的时间。

blocks.en: 6.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.6 限制

blocks.en: The planting of a negation is especially difficult in complex sentences. For example, the test set contains a self-contradiction made by removing a negation, where “the maximum permitted speed of 540 rpm may be exceeded” would become a plausible error if it read “the speed of 540 rpm may be exceeded”. In addition, the test set contains implausible instructions made in the same way, such as “transport people on the machine”. In languages with negative concord, for example Czech and Slovenian, removing “ne” leaves a word for “nobody” or “no”, which means the meaning stays negative. As a result, larger datasets need care in every language, because the changed sentence has to be plausible and not only changed.
blocks.zh: 在复杂的句子中,植入否定语尤其困难。 例如,试验集中包含通过去除否定而做出的自我反射,如果它改为“540 rpm的速度可能超过”,那么“允许的最高速度可能超过540 rpm”。 此外,试验集还载有以同样方式作出的不可信的指示,如“机器上的运输人员”。 在有负面协调的语言中,例如捷克语和斯洛文尼亚语,删除“ne”会留下一个“任何人”或“no”的词,这意味着含义保持不变。 因此,更大的数据集需要注意每种语言,因为修改后的句子必须合理,而不仅仅是更改.

blocks.en: The test sets contain planted errors only, and they contain no errors made by translators. Moreover, all operator manuals come from one manufacturer, and the study uses one model of 1.7 billion parameters. English is the only reference language of the study, and the study checks no pairs between two other languages. In addition, every test manual describes a new model of a machine type that also appears in the training manuals, while a machine type absent from training was not tested. The automatic decision of approach A is imperfect, as neither the element rules nor Clef measure removed conditions reliably. Furthermore, the study replaced the reviewer with an automatic decision and did not measure how a reviewer relies on the flags and explanations of the checker. A user study with reviewers of operator manuals, as done for other texts [ 11 ] , represents a next step. The test manuals overlap with the training text, where 69 % and 42 % of their text units appear word for word in the training manuals. The results show the direction and the size of the effects within this setting, but they do not show general performance figures. In addition, the checks by the author cover Finnish and English only, which means no bilingual check of the planted errors or of the alerts in the other 23 languages was performed. The validation of the plantings favoured short changes in one place, while long conditions and constructions of several words remained underrepresented in the test sets. Moreover, the test sets cover sentences and paragraphs only, whereas headings, lists, tables, captions and text in figures are not covered. Clef filtered the planted errors of the test sets and served as the alternative judge of approach A. However, the element rules made the main decision of approach A, while Clef judged only the removed conditions, whose result is not interpreted. In addition, no pretrained quality-estimation model, such as xCOMET, was compared as a baseline, as the paper compares two training workflows of one LLM, not systems.
blocks.zh: 测试集只包含安装错误,没有翻译员的错误. 此外,所有操作手册都来自一个制造商,该研究使用了17亿参数的模型. 英语是研究的唯一参考语言,研究检查其他两种语言之间没有对称. 此外,每个测试手册都描述了一种同样出现在培训手册中的机器类型的新模型,而没有参加培训的机器类型则没有经过测试. 办法A的自动决定是不完善的,因为要素规则和克莱夫措施都没有可靠地消除条件。 此外,该研究以自动决定取代审查者,没有衡量审查者如何依靠检查者的旗帜和解释。 与其他文本一样,对操作人员手册的审查员进行用户研究是下一步。 测试手册与培训文本重叠,其中69%和42%的文本单位在培训教材中逐字出现。 结果显示了这个设定中效果的方向和大小,但没有显示一般性能数字. 此外,提交人的检查只涉及芬兰语和英语,这意味着没有用双语检查安装的错误或其他23种语言的警报。 植株的验证倾向于在一个地方进行短暂的改变,而几个字的长期条件和构造在测试组中仍然代表性不足。 此外,测试只涵盖句子和段落,而数字中的标题、清单、表格、标题和文本则不涵盖。 Clef过滤了试验套件的安装错误,并担任了方法A的替代判断. 然而,要素规则是办法A的主要决定,而克莱夫只判断被取消的条件,其结果没有被解释. 此外,没有经过预先培训的质量估计模型,如xCOMET,被比作基线,因为论文比较了一个LLM的两个培训工作流程,而不是系统.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Current standards leave the review of every translation to competent persons, and this review process is the bottleneck of multilingual operator manuals. This proof of concept evaluated, within operator manuals of agricultural machinery, whether a fine-tuned LLM keeps visible or detects discrepancies in translated instructions, which represents a precondition for a possible support of that review, not the support itself. The back-translator trained on the manufacturer’s manuals concealed planted errors, especially in text close to the training text, as the pre-registered hypothesis expected. In contrast, the checker trained on the same manuals with synthetic errors detected most of the planted errors, although it remained weak for some unit changes. However, a Finnish check of alerts on real translations showed that most alerts were false, which means that the practical usefulness for naturally written translations remains unestablished, despite the strong detection of planted discrepancies. In addition, the result is in line with earlier observations that back-translation can repair errors on the way back. Overall, the result indicates that a fine-tuned checker might support the review. Firmer conclusions need a far more comprehensive corpus with much more data, and they require an answer to the question of the proper model size.
blocks.zh: 目前的标准将每一份翻译的审查留给主管人员,这一审查过程是多种语文操作手册的瓶颈。 在农业机械操作手册中评价了这一概念的这种证明,即经过微调的LLM是否保持可见或发现翻译指令中的不一致,这是可能支持审查的先决条件,而不是支持本身。 接受过制造商手册培训的后译员隐藏了所埋设的错误,特别是在与培训文本相近的文本中,这是预先登记的假设所预期的。 与此相对照的是,接受过相同手册培训的具有合成错误的检查员发现了大部分被安装错误,尽管对于一些单位变化来说它仍然很弱. 然而,芬兰对真实翻译的警示检查表明,大多数警示是虚假的,这意味着尽管有人强烈检测到人为差异,但自然写作翻译的实际用途仍未确立。 此外,结果与早先的观测结果一致,即回转翻译可以修复回转途中的错误. 总的来说,结果显示,一个经过微调的核对员可能支持审查。 更坚定的结论需要一个更全面得多的数据库,它们需要解决适当的模型规模问题。
